turns.question: What does Form 8-K Item 1.05 require a company to disclose about a material cybersecurity incident, and by when? Cite the regulation, and any 8-K filings in the corpus that report an incident under Item 1.05.

report.markdown:
**The retrieved regulation establishes the Form 8-K reporting obligation, but does not reproduce Item 1.05’s disclosure requirements or its specific deadline.** I therefore cannot confirm the required contents and timing from the available passages.

### Regulation

**17 CFR § 240.13a-11(a)** requires covered registrants to file Form 8-K “within the period specified in that form,” unless substantially the same required information has already been reported. **17 CFR § 240.15d-11(a)** provides the corresponding requirement for registrants reporting under that rule. The retrieved eCFR snapshot is dated **August 17, 2026**. [1]

These provisions point to the form for the deadline; they do **not**, in the retrieved text, specify Item 1.05’s incident-disclosure contents or timing. [1]

### Item 1.05 filings found in the corpus

The following are confirmed examples, not an exhaustive inventory.

| Company | 8-K filing date(s) | Incident reported under Item 1.05 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Conduent (CNDT) | April 14, 2025 | Operational disruption on January 13, 2025, and unauthorized access by a threat actor to part of its environment. [2] |
| Coinbase Global (COIN) | May 15, 2025 | Customer and internal data obtained through support personnel; an extortion email was received May 11, 2025. The filing said passwords and private keys were not compromised. [2] |
| Data I/O (DAIO) | August 21 and September 10, 2025 | Ransomware affecting certain internal IT systems on August 16, 2025; the September filing updated the earlier disclosure. [2] |
| BayFirst Financial (BAFN) | October 30, 2025 | Incident at a third-party marketing provider; the provider confirmed exposure of some customer information on October 28, 2025. [2] |
| Coupang (CPNG) | December 16, 2025 | Unauthorized access to customer accounts; its Korean subsidiary became aware of the incident on November 18, 2025. [2] |

**Limitations:** Item 1.05’s operative text was not retrieved, and some returned passages were truncated; the exact disclosure requirements, deadline, and exceptions remain unverified.
